comment: Very easy class. Ideal for non-STEM students who need to complete science gen ed. Very lecture heavy. Labs are super easy. All lecture quizzes are open note and test questions come from the quizzes. Nice and kind professor and the content of the course was interesting and relevant. Attendance is not worth much but you will miss labs if you skip
LOVE Dr. Scott. Great professor and super caring and sweet. Her class "people and the planet" is so interesting and informative.
Great teacher, an easy class, and good material would 100% recommend it.
Great professor, the material she gives is clear and the assignments aren't hard. The labs are fun, the lectures can be very long but she's always available to help.
